Name: same-version
Summary: Returns true when all five semantic-version components match exactly.

Parameters.Name: version
Parameters.Summary: The semantic version compared with the pipeline input.

Evaluation.Summary: Evaluated once in the context enclosing this same-version call.

Name: lower-precedence
Summary: Returns true when the pipeline input has lower SemVer precedence than the parameter.

Parameters.Name: version
Parameters.Summary: The semantic version compared with the pipeline input.

Evaluation.Summary: Evaluated once in the context enclosing this lower-precedence call.

Name: higher-precedence
Summary: Returns true when the pipeline input has higher SemVer precedence than the parameter.

Parameters.Name: version
Parameters.Summary: The semantic version compared with the pipeline input.

Evaluation.Summary: Evaluated once in the context enclosing this higher-precedence call.

Name: same-precedence
Summary: Returns true when the pipeline input has equal SemVer precedence, ignoring build metadata.

Parameters.Name: version
Parameters.Summary: The semantic version compared with the pipeline input.

Evaluation.Summary: Evaluated once in the context enclosing this same-precedence call.

Name: same-major
Summary: Returns true when the major components match.

Parameters.Name: version

Evaluation.Summary: Evaluated once in the context enclosing this same-major call.

Name: same-minor
